Nova-3 is Deepgram's highest-performing general-purpose ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition) model, recommended for meetings, event captioning, multi-speaker, multilingual, noisy, or far-field audio in both batch and streaming modes.


It represents a significant leap forward in speech AI technology, delivering industry-leading performance with a 53.4% reduction in word error rate (WER) for streaming and 47.4% for batch processing compared to competitors.


Nova-3 offers model options such as general (optimized for everyday audio processing) and medical (optimized for audio with medically oriented vocabulary, available in English and multilingual).


To access the model, you simply use model=nova-3 in your API calls.
